answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and called out as primary-region-only, which matches the March latency recovery via regional failover (b2) better than the other playbooks. Failover is the intended single intervention because it can restore availability while continuing to accept customer writes. The release two hours ago is a real alternate cause (b1), so that hypothesis is not dismissed; rollback is the next candidate if failover is contraindicated in the archive. Circuit breaking (b4) is rejected: failing fast would drop settlement writes and violates the objective. Peak settlement means any write-path move has downstream value risk (in-flight/settlement completeness), and it is not established that the other region has equivalent write headroom. Capacity and read-replica routing are weaker fits to a region-scoped write-path symptom and are left for a later window.
